data.name: Danette
data.gender_notes: Danette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Danai, meaning 'Danaos' daughter. In Greek mythology, Danai was a legendary woman who was given 50 daughters by Zeus. 'Danette' is a modern variation of this ancient name, and it carries the beautiful meaning of 'God's gift'. The name Danette carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Danette usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine gift of life and the blessings bestowed upon us by the Creator.
data.etymology: Danette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Danette total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: דָּנִית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Danette is derived from the Hebrew word 'דָּנִית' (dānîṯ), which means 'God is my judge'. This name conveys a sense of trust and reliance on God for judgment and justice.

in_greek.name: Δανέττα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name Danette is 'Δανέττα' (Danétta). This name follows the common pattern of transliterating Hebrew names into the Greek language.

in_latin.name: Danetta
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Danette is 'Danetta'. This name is simply the Latinization of the Greek form of the name.

in_english.name: Danette
in_english.long_meaning: The English form of the name Danette is the same as the original Hebrew name. It is a modern name that has gained popularity in the English-speaking world.

data.cultural_impact: "Danette" is a Christian name with origins tracing back to the ancient Greek culture and mythology. It is a name that signifies a rich heritage and connection to the past. The name has been used throughout history by Christians as a meaningful and unique choice for their daughters.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name "Danette" holds great spiritual significance as it represents the idea of being a blessed and cherished gift from God. It is a reminder of God's infinite love and grace, and the importance of appreciating and honoring the gifts that He bestows upon us. Additionally, it may serve as a reminder of the biblical story of Danai and her daughters, who were recipients of divine favor and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Danette: God is my judge. The name Danette carries a sense of trust and reliance in God's divine justice. It symbolizes a strong faith that God will be the ultimate arbiter in matters of one's life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Danette is mentioned in the 13th century as a variant of the name Dianette. The name Danette carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Danette was used in medieval England as a feminine given name.
